what: IFEval counts bullet points with '^\s*\*[^\*].*$' and '^\s*-.*$' (re.MULTILINE) and passes only on EXACT equality with the required count. The dash pattern needs no space after '-', so a negative number, a '---' rule or a stray dash line is counted as a bullet; the asterisk pattern counts a '*italic*' line as a bullet. Under exact equality this flips verdicts in both directions.

method.corpus: 7 hand-traced cases; verdict = checker exact-equality vs ground truth.
method.corrected_count: count only marker lines followed by a space and content (a rendered CommonMark list item).
method.exposure: across GPT-4 responses to the bullet-requiring prompts: how many contain a counted-but-unrendered marker line, how many have an inflated count, and in how many the inflation flips the exact-equality verdict; examples kept for manual review.
